brief.purpose: Use Codex to build people-centred technology that makes learning easier to reach, easier to sustain, and easier to act on.
brief.intended_impact: Help someone become a lifelong learner: find what they need, stay engaged, and turn learning into real opportunity.
brief.scope: A working proof of concept demonstrating usefulness, viability, and potential for further development; production-ready software is not required.
brief.idea_origin_guidance: The supplied brief asks participants to originate their capstone idea without AI idea generation. Codex can help refine the user's observations and concept, validate, specify, build, review, and document.
operating_constraints: Accurate learning materials traceable to credible sources.
Usefulness with low bandwidth, limited data, unreliable internet, and basic devices.
Accessibility across literacy, disability, digital confidence, and technology access.
Personalization that does not exclude learners outside a standard profile.
Privacy and security for personal, academic, and performance information.
Local relevance of curricula, credentials, institutions, and opportunities.
brief.full_brief_source: User-pasted capstone brief on 2026-10-03, consistent with the signed-in LMS observation. It permits cross-track entries but supplies no submission date; the user's exactly-one-track instruction remains in force.
brief.selected_track: Engagement & Staying in the Learning Journey
brief.project_idea: One cohesive Track 2 product for learners generally: TinySteps, Comeback, personal study/review cycles and private peer StudyCircle, flexible nonpunitive consistency, and FinishLine. All five capabilities are committed; their effectiveness is unvalidated.
